analysis.visual_description: On the tables. The tables open on the board upstairs. The red bundle is at the far side, still knotted. Gib is on the shut book, out of this leaf.
On the tables. He writes under the three words and stops. The bundle is not opened.
On the tables. The stylus is down. He does not add a name, a sum, or a line of a play. The knot is in the same place.
On the tables. He looks up. Three apples on the sill, the same bruise. The leaf is unchanged when he looks back.
